## Bring your own questions

If you already have a project in mind where you're wondering whether LLM-based classification would fit, bring it — we're happy to think through it together.

## Where to go from here

- The [Tutorials](/sections/tutorials/index.qmd) section on this site has full walkthroughs and local installation instructions.
- All of today's notebooks and data are on [this workshop's GitHub repository](https://github.com/felixdidi/llm-content-analysis/tree/main/sections/workshop).
- Hugging Face's own course is a good next step if you want to go deeper: <https://huggingface.co/learn>.

Thank you for spending your morning with us!
